description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various emotional categories. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct emotional category. The slices are labeled as "Illustration" (light blue, 25.1%), an unlabeled category (dark blue, 23.1%), "Happiness" (blue, 8.1%), "Excitement" (red, 14.1%), an unlabeled category (orange, 14.7%), and "Anger" (yellow, 14.9%). The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, but does not have a legend. The slices are arranged in no particular order by size, with "Illustration" being the largest visible slice and "Happiness" being the smallest. None of the slices are visually emphasized.
